verdict.rationale: Lovable offers some isolation mechanisms. Collaborators can work in drafts, which are separate copies of the project with their own chat and preview. Remixing creates an independent copy, Git sync lets you test features on branches, and publishing deploys a snapshot, which implies the editor preview is kept apart from the live app. None of the evidence says whether these copies get their own database or whether testing in them avoids production data, since the built-in Cloud backend is presented as one production-ready environment. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or staging environment with isolated test data, documented separation of preview data from published production data, and independent corroboration.
